english.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for things related to commerce or business, especially before a noun such as 商業活動.
This is the all-purpose choice for things concerned with trade or business for profit.

examples.english: Our company has been holding many more commercial activities lately.
examples.traditional: 我哋公司近排多咗好多商業活動。

examples.english: This company is mainly engaged in mercantile trade, exporting local goods.
examples.traditional: 呢間公司主要做商業貿易，將本地貨品出口。
